assumptions: Directional calibration bounds apply to this at-risk subpopulation.
Judge errors on the two arms are independent given true labels.
The at-risk set is majority-real (the true baseline appropriate-label rate is at least one half).

resolution.correlated_error_note: Assumes the judge's per-arm errors are independent given the true labels. Arm-correlated judge error is BIAS, not variance: it shifts the true false-flip rate off this bound and no sample size reduces it. This MDE is conditional on that assumption and does not correct for it.
resolution.eps_definition: per-arm upper bound on BOTH directional judge-error rates (max of false-compliance and false-refusal upper CIs)
resolution.eps_source: bound calibration report SHA256 c4363820c83be74e7ae213ff3684818eaefffdbf171a2284f4149b14c18ad014; scope f0612bfade2a9c35bc0146a171985e7ce99369ff0ca57b9d32b195bd39eb8313; label truth not authenticated
resolution.headline: effective MDE ~100pp at n=24 and 80% power (>=16 of 24 at-risk pairs must read flipped to reject H0 at alpha=0.05; false-flip bound 43.9pp per pair); assumes arm-independent judge error
resolution.test: one-sided exact binomial upper tail on observed flips among at-risk pairs
